newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bank of the Ryukyus to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: Bank of the Ryukyus to issue new shares.

text.p: The Bank of the Ryukyus Ltd said on Monday it had decided to issue 3.35 million new shares in order to increase its capital.
The Okinawa-based regional bank said in a statement it expected to raise 6.20 billion yen through the new issue, pricing the new shares at 1,850 yen.
New shares will be allotted to holders of the bank's shares as of January 31 at 0.3 new share for every existing share.
Applications for the new shares should be made between March 7 and 17 and the payment date is March 31, it said.
On Monday the bank's shares closed at 3,900 yen, unchanged from their close on December 30.
